records.observation:
Complete257-line javap. Constructor initializers then redundant assignments result isOnfalse, ilevel0, lineHeadtrue, new StringBuffer, text_areanull. setActive only changes plain nonvolatile boolean; isActive only reads. print/println NEVER consult isOn, so activity gating is caller responsibility. No synchronized method/EDT marshalling despite StringBuffer individual methods being synchronized; multi-step shared level/head/buffer operations can race.
initTextArea(title) returns immediately if inactive; active creates NEW JTextArea10x30 and JScrollPane/JFrame, adds/packs/shows. Does not make readonly, cap log size, set close operation/listener, retain JFrame handle, dispose oldframe or preserve visible old output. Repeated init replaces text_area reference, leaving earlier windows and their old text intact; setActive(false) neither hides window nor clears buffer. GUI actions run on caller thread.
setFilename unconditionally creates FileOutputStream(filename) without append then PrintStream and System.setOut. Thus creates/truncates file and redirects process-global stdout even when inactive; no own stream retention, prior stream close/restore, stderr redirection, charset choice or exception recovery. Method declares IOException; no security/argument validation. This is static analysis only; no archived output routine executed or file truncated during review.
print(s) tests s.indexOf(END)>0, not>=0: marker at start ignored, first occurrenceat0 means later occurrences do not count either; any embedded positive-position occurrence decrements indent before text, no token boundary check. If lineHead, appends UnitIndentStr four spaces ilevel times only while>0; appends s and lineHeadfalse; tests first START index>0 and increments after append. One increment/decrement max per call even repeated markers. No nullguard (indexOf first), negative-level clamp, reset, overflow/size bound or newline inspection within s. print NEVERflushes even if resulting level0.
println uses same END-before-indent/START-after-append policy, appends literal newline and sets lineHeadtrue. ONLY if resulting ilevel EXACT0: sends full buffer to current System.out.print then flush when no text_area, otherwise JTextArea.append then caret=documentlength; afterward replaces StringBuffer. At positive OR negative level retains buffer with no size limit, no timeout/close flush. Unbalanced markers or incidental substrings can defer output indefinitely; incomplete print-only lines also remain buffered. Both END and START in same message decrement then increment, netzero but affects indentation. Sink errors can skip buffer replacement; no finally. Connects caller debug/profiling START/END strings to buffered output, not reliable independent execution-completion evidence. No approved semantic completion or runtime GUI test.
